description: Watch a GitHub-pull-request Teams message for a reaction; record a GitHub review through a second identity, refuse to approve while checks fail, and optionally merge once approved and checks pass.

repo.label: Repo
repo.description: GitHub repository to act on, 'owner/repo'. Must match the repo sensors/github_pull_request_agent_sensor watches.

token_env_var.label: Token Env Var
token_env_var.description: Env var holding the primary GitHub token (reads, checks CI).

reviewer_token_env_var.label: Reviewer Token Env Var
reviewer_token_env_var.description: Env var holding a SECOND GitHub token (a distinct bot/user identity with write access) -- required to actually record an approval. GitHub blocks a PR's own author approving it.

reviewer_login.label: Reviewer Login
reviewer_login.description: The reviewer (second) identity's GitHub username -- checked before merging, to confirm THAT identity (not just anyone) approved.

api_base_url.label: Api Base Url
api_base_url.description: API base URL. Change for GitHub Enterprise Server.

branch_prefix.label: Branch Prefix
branch_prefix.description: Only branches with this prefix are ever merged automatically.

teams_team_id.label: Teams Team Id
teams_team_id.description: The SAME Teams team id sensors/github_pull_request_agent_sensor (platform='teams') posts to.

teams_channel_id.label: Teams Channel Id
teams_channel_id.description: The SAME Teams channel id sensors/github_pull_request_agent_sensor (platform='teams') posts to.

teams_tenant_id_env_var.label: Teams Tenant Id Env Var
teams_tenant_id_env_var.description: Env var holding the Azure AD tenant id.

teams_client_id_env_var.label: Teams Client Id Env Var
teams_client_id_env_var.description: Env var holding the Azure AD app registration client id.

teams_client_secret_env_var.label: Teams Client Secret Env Var
teams_client_secret_env_var.description: Env var holding the Azure AD app registration client secret.

teams_refresh_token_env_var.label: Teams Refresh Token Env Var
teams_refresh_token_env_var.description: Env var holding the OAuth refresh token.

history_lookback_hours.label: History Lookback Hours
history_lookback_hours.description: How far back (hours) to scan the channel for still-open PR-review messages.

post_branch_deployment_link.label: Post Branch Deployment Link
post_branch_deployment_link.description: Post 'A branch deployment of this change is ready to test: <link>' once in a PR's Teams thread, when the PR has a Dagster+ branch deployment link and is NOT low risk (per protected_paths / low_risk_paths / low_risk_max_files / low_risk_max_lines), so a person approving in Teams can try the change first.

protected_paths.label: Protected Paths
protected_paths.description: Risk assessment for post_branch_deployment_link: a PR touching one of these paths is not low risk. Same matching convention and defaults as github_pr_tools' protected_paths.

low_risk_paths.label: Low Risk Paths
low_risk_paths.description: Risk assessment for post_branch_deployment_link: a PR changing only these paths (within the size limits, checks passing) is low risk and gets no link. Same convention and defaults as github_pr_tools' low_risk_paths.

low_risk_max_files.label: Low Risk Max Files
low_risk_max_files.description: Risk assessment for post_branch_deployment_link: max changed files for a low-risk PR.

low_risk_max_lines.label: Low Risk Max Lines
low_risk_max_lines.description: Risk assessment for post_branch_deployment_link: max changed lines (additions + deletions) for a low-risk PR.

auto_merge.label: Auto Merge
auto_merge.description: When True, squash-merge automatically once the reviewer identity has approved and checks pass (still gated by branch_prefix).

minimum_interval_seconds.label: Minimum Interval Seconds
minimum_interval_seconds.description: Sensor cadence -- how often to poll Teams + GitHub.

skip_in_branch_deployments.label: Skip In Branch Deployments
skip_in_branch_deployments.description: Skip every tick while running inside a Dagster+ branch deployment (DAGSTER_CLOUD_IS_BRANCH_DEPLOYMENT=1). A branch deployment runs its own copy of every sensor alongside the full deployment's -- without this, a branch deployment double-posts Teams replies and double-records GitHub reviews/merges for the same vote.

refresh_other_agent_prs_after_merge.label: Refresh Other Agent Prs After Merge
refresh_other_agent_prs_after_merge.description: After auto_merge successfully merges a PR, bring every OTHER open branch_prefix PR up to date with the new base_branch (GitHub's update-branch API) so their CI runs against the just-merged code instead of a stale base, the same reconciliation github_pr_tools' refresh_open_agent_prs tool does manually. Best-effort -- a PR that can't be updated (e.g. a real merge conflict) is skipped, never raised. Ignored when auto_merge is false.

verify_after_merge.label: Verify After Merge
verify_after_merge.description: After auto_merge merges a PR, look for 'Fixes failed run <uuid>' or 'Run ID: <uuid>' in the PR body (the same convention failed_run_agent_sensor's launched fixer asset should put there) and re-execute that failed run (Dagster's launchRunReexecution, ALL_STEPS strategy) against the just-merged code, then post pass/fail/timeout in the PR's Teams thread once it resolves -- 'the fix worked' is then something this sensor confirms, not something it assumes. Requires dagster_url and dagster_cloud_api_token_env_var. Ignored when auto_merge is false, since there's nothing to verify until a merge actually happens.

post_merge_command.label: Post Merge Command
post_merge_command.description: Only used when verify_after_merge is true. An optional shell command run once, right before launching the verification re-run -- e.g. a deploy/redeploy step so the re-run actually executes against the just-merged code instead of whatever was already running. A non-zero exit skips verification and reports the failure in the thread instead.

dagster_url.label: Dagster Url
dagster_url.description: Base Dagster(+) URL (e.g. 'https://org.dagster.cloud/prod'). Required when verify_after_merge is true -- both for the GraphQL endpoint (<dagster_url>/graphql) and for building run links in Teams messages.

dagster_cloud_api_token_env_var.label: Dagster Cloud Api Token Env Var
dagster_cloud_api_token_env_var.description: Only used when verify_after_merge is true. Env var holding a Dagster+ API token with permission to launch runs in this deployment.

verify_timeout_minutes.label: Verify Timeout Minutes
verify_timeout_minutes.description: Only used when verify_after_merge is true. Give up waiting for the verification re-run after this many minutes and report a timeout instead of a pass/fail.
